examples.text: So manche Erwachsenen wiederum können nicht verstehen, warum sie nicht damit aufhören können, suchtartig Filme herunterzuladen oder stundenlang in Online-Chats zu verbringen.

examples.text: There were moments when I doubted whether it was worth all the effort – whether it was crazy of Anderson to toil so obsessively over three breezy, cheeky vignettes which are neither sidesplittingly hilarious nor heart-wrenchingly insightful.

translations.source_sense_description: Merkmale einer Sucht aufweisend, in der Art einer Sucht

examples.text: The idea is too tempting, it's obsessive.

glosses: Having one thought or pursuing one activity to the absolute or nearly absolute exclusion of all others.

examples.text: Hardcore fans' obsessive behavior may take over their lives.
A workaholic's obsessive zeal may lead to success or burnout.

Yes, there were instances of grandstanding and obsessive behaviour, but many were concealed at the time to help protect an aggressively peddled narrative of [Oscar] Pistorius the paragon, the emblem, the trailblazer.

glosses: A person who is obsessed, who has an obsession.
